Demonstrated track record of negotiating and executing complex, high-value strategic transactions, potentially including acquisitions, licensing transactions, collaborations, co-development agreements, investments, and other innovative transaction structures.
Deep understanding of biopharmaceutical strategy, drug development, commercialization, portfolio management, valuation, and transaction economics.
Strong strategic and financial acumen with demonstrated ability to evaluate opportunities through both enterprise strategy and capital allocation lenses.

Exceptional negotiation skills and demonstrated ability to navigate complex transactions involving scientific, clinical, commercial, intellectual property, financial, operational, and legal considerations.
Experience advising executive leadership and presenting sophisticated strategic and transaction recommendations to senior executives and Boards of Directors.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and create alignment among senior stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.
Strong external network across the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, investment, banking, and broader life sciences ecosystem.
Proven people and organizational leadership experience, including building, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, high-growth environment and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Exceptional communication, executive presence, judgment, and ability to influence at the highest levels of an organization.
preferred_qualifications: At minimum of 15 years of experience in biotech or pharmaceuticals industry, preferable in oncology, with at least 10 years in business or corporate development leadership roles.
Advanced degree in a scientific, medical, business, legal, or related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
